principles: Reuse existing tracking functionality and user data; inspect actual application before modifying UI.
Track the user's selected goals, not merely supplement consumption.
BASIC follow-up and safety warnings remain accessible without PRO payment.
No automated medical diagnosis or claim of efficacy from self-reported changes.
Respect privacy, consent, and data deletion.

goal_progress.comparison: changes over time without causal attribution

actions: record changes in medications or conditions
safety_checkin.warning: New adverse effects or relevant medication changes require review; do not auto-clear safety blocks.

items: PRO results only when purchased and available

integrations.basic_results: initialize tracking only with user consent
integrations.pro: parallel optional paid analysis, not required for tracking
integrations.cart: parallel optional shopping, purchase does not activate tracking automatically
integrations.library: link to corresponding compound scientific sheet

implementation_note: This contract does not claim that tracking UI or persistence has been implemented; verify the existing app's components, storage, and consent flow first.
